name: Karwendelcamp Scharnitz
beschreibung: The campsite Karwendelcamp Scharnitz is located in the municipality of Scharnitz in Tirol, near the German border. It lies in the Isar valley at the entrance to the Karwendelgebirge, one of the largest nature park landscapes of the Ostalpen. The surroundings are characterized by rock faces and coniferous forests, which are used for hiking and climbing routes. In winter, ski areas such as Seefeld, about ten kilometers away, are available to guests. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as sanitary facilities and electricity connections. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature, due to the secluded valley location. Here, guests can expect a base for outdoor activities in the Alpine region.
